attempt_insert.statement: INSERT INTO webhook_attempt (delivery_id, outcome, at_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?)

ledger_by_id.statement: SELECT delivery_id, digest, event, subscription, outcome, received_ms FROM webhook_ledger WHERE delivery_id = ? LIMIT ?

ledger_insert.statement: INSERT INTO webhook_ledger (delivery_id, digest, event, subscription, outcome, received_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

outbox_by_id.statement: SELECT delivery_id, event, subscription, state, attempts, updated_ms, worker_id, lease_until_ms, version FROM webhook_outbox WHERE delivery_id = ? LIMIT ?

outbox_insert.statement: INSERT INTO webhook_outbox (delivery_id, event, subscription, state, attempts, updated_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

outbox_update.statement: UPDATE webhook_outbox SET state = ?, attempts = ?, updated_ms = ? WHERE delivery_id = ?

claim_candidate.statement: SELECT delivery_id, event, subscription, state, attempts, updated_ms, worker_id, lease_until_ms, version FROM webhook_outbox WHERE delivery_id = (SELECT delivery_id FROM webhook_outbox WHERE state = ? AND lease_until_ms <= ? ORDER BY updated_ms, delivery_id LIMIT 1) LIMIT ?

claim_update.statement: UPDATE webhook_outbox SET worker_id = ?, lease_until_ms = ?, version = ?, updated_ms = ? WHERE delivery_id = ? AND version = ?

heartbeat_update.statement: UPDATE webhook_outbox SET lease_until_ms = ?, version = ?, updated_ms = ? WHERE delivery_id = ? AND worker_id = ? AND version = ?

outbox_dead.statement: UPDATE webhook_outbox SET state = ?, updated_ms = ? WHERE delivery_id = ?

dead_insert.statement: INSERT INTO webhook_dead_letter (delivery_id, event, subscription, reason, attempts, dead_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
